title: Raises and lifestyle creep are a trap
body: I'm 30 and a night shift nurse, and I think a lot of people get caught up in chasing raises without controlling spending. I've seen folks get a bump and immediately start buying nicer things, which just makes the new income disappear fast. You have to be really disciplined about keeping your baseline spending the same, no matter how much more money you bring in. It’s about keeping the gains, not just chasing the next paycheck bump.

title: Drought and well water reality check
body: I've seen enough years to know that when the rains don't come, the well is the only lifeline. Some folks talk about fancy irrigation systems, but in a real drought, that just pulls more water into a desperate fight. Relying solely on deep well water without a real plan for conservation is just setting yourself up for a bigger crisis down the line. You have to respect what the land gives you right now.
